preset_notes.Skelly Mocap: Tuned for FreeMoCap: Linear lens keeps distortion close to a standard pinhole model for calibration, stabilization OFF is required (in-camera stabilization invalidates a fixed calibration), 60fps caps exposure to reduce motion blur. Anti-flicker set to 50Hz for EU/UK mains - change to 60Hz if shooting on 60Hz power.
preset_notes.HMC Stereo: Set by hand on each camera: Protune ON, White Balance 4500K, ISO 300, Shutter 1/200 (no remote API for these on GoPro - Protune/ISO/white balance/shutter speed can't be pushed from the app).
